Definition: from G1223 and the base of G3551; to distribute, i.e. (of information) to disseminate:--spread.
BiblicalUsage: To spread abroad is what the rulers feared the gospel would do, and they were right. The apostles are warned to speak no more in the name of Jesus, lest the word spread further among the people, but the warning only proves how far it has already gone.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the gospel spreads because it cannot be contained; the rulers tried to stop it with a threat, and the threat itself is the confession that the name of Jesus was already on every tongue in Jerusalem.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
